teaser: Pay for the share of a page you read, go below zero with no nagging, top up £5 on Stripe: the plan, and the numbers we check in eight weeks.
core_idea: The reading meter goes live as an honesty box rather than a paywall: pages are charged by scroll depth, the balance may go below zero forever, there is no ask and no banner, readers can decline to pay with a reason, and topping up is one £5 Stripe payment credited by an unverified return page; the business case is evidence, not revenue, and five hypotheses with thresholds and a review date are written down before the first payment.

nodes.label: Pay for the share you read
nodes.summary: A page costs its price times the deepest point scrolled to, never less than a tenth.

nodes.label: Below zero, forever, without shame
nodes.summary: Nothing blocked, nothing shown but a small balance in the top bar.

nodes.label: Not worth it? Don't charge me
nodes.summary: Refund with a reason, kept locally as a signal for the picks.

nodes.label: The Guardian's counter and ask
nodes.summary: Weekly article counts in localStorage used to ask for support; £4, £12 and £27 a month, £107m digital reader revenue.

nodes.label: The subscription commitment
nodes.summary: £4 a month is £48 a year, decided before the reading happens.

nodes.label: An honesty box, not a paywall
nodes.summary: Bagels about 87 to 95% paid; Radiohead 38%; pay-what-you-want raises take-up and lowers the average.

nodes.label: One £5 Stripe payment
nodes.summary: 1.5% + 20p on a standard UK card, about 5.5%; the return page credits without verifying.

nodes.label: The business case is evidence
nodes.summary: A payment is the only signal on the site curiosity cannot produce.

nodes.label: Five hypotheses and a review date
nodes.summary: First payment in 14 days, 10 payers, 3 repeat payers, no disputes, below zero is normal; review eight weeks after the link goes live.

nodes.label: SG Meter, a library
nodes.summary: One web component any site can add, with config, events, storage and a security model.

quotes.text: And going below zero is not a failure state.
quotes.why: The design choice that separates this meter from a paywall or an ask.

quotes.text: A payment is the only signal on this site that cannot be produced by curiosity.
quotes.why: The business case in one line.

quotes.text: The one outcome that would be a failure of the method is not looking.
quotes.why: Why the hypotheses are written down before the results.
